title: Momoi Airi — For A Bigger, Better Stream〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall
Electronics Store

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... The ring lights are...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, right over here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If we want more viewers, we should start using this kind of equipment for our streams.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Wow, they have a huge selection here...
Choosing which to buy warrants some consideration, but how do they all differ...?)

rows.Speaker: Store Clerk
rows.Line: Are you looking to buy a ring light, miss?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, I'm pretty staggered by your selection. I really don't know what I should be looking for...

rows.Speaker: Store Clerk
rows.Line:
These are in high demand with so many people streaming and making videos lately, so...
Wait, aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Uh oh... Did she figure out who I am...?)

rows.Speaker: Store Clerk
rows.Line:
Please pardon my indiscretion.
You're looking for a light to use during your streams, yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I see... She must be used to this sort of thing. I really appreciate her professionalism.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, it's for our streams.
Something portable with multiple lighting options would be ideal.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. That clerk lady was so helpful. I got just what we needed.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We'll need to test it out before our next stream.)
Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I had a feeling it was you!
Hi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, Saki!
Are you on your way home from band practice?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I am! Were you out shopping just now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I just went to buy a ring light for our streams.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We rely on natural light when we stream from the school's rooftop, but...
There's no guarantee it'll always be sunny, y'know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
This means your streams are gonna become even better, right?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka even said how she's switching back to the credit-based course, so I'm even more excited about what MORE MORE JUMP! has in store for us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So Haruka already told her...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She's an idol through and through, so there's no reason for me to doubt her commitment...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But how do her friends feel...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Were you surprised when she told you about that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Kinda...
But I know her!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know she's a really inspiring idol who can spread hope to lots and lots more people♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, as her friend, I wanna keep giving her all the support I can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You too, Airi!
I'm gonna be rooting for you like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks! MORE MORE JUMP! is gonna become an idol group that makes everyone's day brighter just from hearing our name!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! That's so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're not gonna let you hog all the glory!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're gonna sign with a label, post lots of songs to our channel and play shows everywhere we can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's great! And I'm sure you'll be able to as long as you believe in yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... Then we might even get a chance to play on TV together someday♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah, you're right.
Let's keep dreaming big, the both of us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Right... Saki cares deeply about her friends, their dreams and what they want to do...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm so glad she's friends with Haruka and Minori.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This might sound weird coming from me, but I hope you'll keep being friends with Haruka and Minori...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! We're gonna be friends forever and ever and eeever♪
